svg.text: Two ways a remote reaches the host
The declarative path exists only to make live HMR possible in dev; production is dynamic throughout
Extension B always, and Extension A in production
literal call site, rewritten by the plugin
No remotes entry, no import, no route.
Production aliases in an inert stub module.
served by its own Vite dev server
dev.remoteHmr swaps the module, no reload,
a few seconds, Pinia state survives
A production build compiles the left column away: no remotes are declared, and Extension A takes the right-hand path.
Adding a new extension: declarative needs a host code change; dynamic needs none.
